As the second line of defence for model risk and AI governance, MRM defines and maintains model risk management standards, performs independent validations, and leads the Bank’s AI governance framework.

The MRM team is responsible for managing and reporting model risks across all model families, ranging from established financial and risk models to emerging AI and machine learning solutions. In this role, you will help strengthen the Bank’s capabilities in the governance, control, and validation of AI/ML use, contributing to a robust, risk-based approach that fosters trust in Commerzbank’s rapidly expanding AI landscape.

jobs.excerpt: Part-time: 20-30 hours per month Details: Competitive hourly rate (Senior, Fractional).
jobs.description:
Part-time: 20-30 hours per month

Details: Competitive hourly rate (Senior, Fractional). Long-term engagement if mutually successful

Job ID: 26FRA301

Fractional Product Systems Designer (Web + iOS) - Remote (U.S.- based)

Overview

Serious Development builds internal business applications at speed using: v0 for prototyping, Angular + PrimeNG for implementation, Native iOS apps that feel like iOS, not web-on-a-phone. We are seeking a Fractional Product Systems Designer (Web + iOS) to design how our products behave over time.

Why This Role Exists

We build internal business applications at speed using:

  • v0 for prototyping
  • Angular + PrimeNG for implementation
  • Native iOS apps that must feel like iOS, not web-on-a-phone

As our velocity increased, traditional screen-based design became unnecessary. What did become necessary is system-level UX ownership.

This role exists to ensure our products remain:

  • Predictable
  • Consistent
  • Native to their platforms
  • Easy to learn and hard to misuse

You will not be designing every screen. You will be designing how the product behaves over time.

Who You Are

Required

  • Senior-level product or systems designer
  • Experience with internal or enterprise applications
  • Strong systems thinking; comfortable defining rules and constraints
  • Deep familiarity with iOS as a platform (not just mobile UI)
  • Comfortable challenging PMs and saying “don’t ship that”
  • Pragmatic, opinionated, and not precious about visuals

Strong Plus

  • Experience cleaning up inconsistent products
  • Familiarity with component-based design systems
  • Experience working with engineers directly
  • Prior fractional or advisory roles

Red Flags (for us)

  • Portfolio-first, system-light background
  • Strong preference for redesigns over convergence
  • Focus on “delight” over clarity and predictability
  • Reliance on Figma as the primary output

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Product-wide UX coherence

  • Own interaction patterns across the product
  • Ensure similar problems are solved the same way
  • Reduce inconsistency as new modules are added
  • Prevent UX drift as multiple PMs and teams ship in parallel

Working within existing products

  • Audit current applications and patterns
  • Identify what already works and should be preserved
  • Drive convergence — not redesign-for-the-sake-of-redesign
  • Respect user muscle memory

Web UX (Angular + PrimeNG)

  • Define how PrimeNG components are used (tables, forms, filters, modals)
  • Establish behavioral standards:
  • States
  • Errors
  • Permissions
  • Progressive disclosure
  • Prevent “almost-the-same” component variants

iOS UX (Native-first)

  • Ensure strict alignment with Apple Human Interface Guidelines
  • Catch web/Android patterns leaking into iOS
  • Enforce native navigation, gestures, and control usage
  • Prioritize platform correctness over internal consistency when they conflict

Partnering with PMs

  • Review v0 prototypes and early implementations
  • Provide fast, opinionated feedback
  • Help PMs reason through UX tradeoffs
  • Establish clear guardrails PMs can confidently operate within

What You Will Not Be Doing

  • Pixel-perfect mock production
  • Designing every feature or screen
  • Maintaining Figma parity with code
  • Visual branding or marketing design
  • Creating handoff artifacts for engineers
  • If your default output is screens, this is not the right role.

What Success Looks Like

  • UX feels consistent across modules and platforms
  • PMs move fast without inventing new patterns
  • Fewer usability questions from users
  • Faster onboarding with less training
  • No “why does this work differently over here?” moments
  • No large-scale UX rewrites six months later

How You’ll Work

  • Review-heavy, not production-heavy
  • Embedded early in feature thinking, not late-stage polish
  • Prefer rules, patterns, and written guidance over visuals
  • Use Figma only when a concept cannot be expressed clearly in text or prototypes
  • Code and prototypes are the source of truth.

Job Title: Senior Service Program Director

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Description Summary

The Senior Service Program Director is responsible for leading the overall success of strategic customer service partnerships by driving customer satisfaction, operational performance, program governance, retention, profitable growth, and long-term partnership value. This role serves as the senior customer-facing leader and strategic point of accountability for assigned enterprise healthcare systems, ensuring GE HealthCare delivers on service commitments, operational expectations, contractual obligations, and business outcomes.

The Senior Director provides business and program management leadership across the GE HealthCare–customer service partnership, developing strategies that support customer satisfaction, retention, growth, and operational excellence. This role works in close alignment with Executive Client Director, regional service teams, functional centers of excellence, commercial partners, finance, field service, supply chain, engineering, and executive leadership to ensure a coordinated, enterprise-wide approach to customer success.

This role also includes direct people leadership responsibility for 5+ direct reports, which may include Service Program Managers, Enterprise Program Managers, Asset Management Leaders, and other customer operations or program leadership roles. The Senior Director is accountable for building team capability, setting clear expectations, coaching performance, aligning work to business priorities, and ensuring consistent execution across the customer operations organization.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Customer Partnership & Executive Engagement

  • Serve as the senior strategic customer interface for assigned enterprise service partnerships.
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with executive, operational, clinical, technical, and administrative customer stakeholders.
  • Establish trusted partnership with customer leadership to understand priorities, business objectives, pain points, and opportunities for value creation.
  • Lead executive governance discussions, strategic business reviews, and senior-level customer engagement routines.
  • Represent GE HealthCare in strategic, operational, contractual, and business discussions with the customer.
  • Protect and strengthen the customer relationship by ensuring issues are addressed proactively, transparently, and with clear ownership.
  • Identify opportunities to expand partnership value, strengthen retention, and protect against competitive threats.

2. Service Partnership Governance & Operational Leadership

  • Lead the overall governance model for assigned customer partnerships, ensuring clear operating mechanisms, escalation paths, communication routines, and decision-making processes are in place.
  • Implement robust reporting and review processes to track service performance, program progress, KPIs, customer commitments, operational risks, financial performance, and project status.
  • Ensure internal and external governance routines are effective, action-oriented, and aligned to customer and GE HealthCare objectives.
  • Facilitate alignment across account teams, regional service teams, field service, functional centers of excellence, and commercial partners.
  • Drive operational discipline across customer programs to ensure commitments, deliverables, and improvement actions are completed on time.
  • Lead regular program, technical, operational, and executive reviews with customers and internal leadership.

3. People Leadership & Team Development

  • Directly lead, coach, and develop a team of 5+ direct reports, including roles such as SPM, EPM, AML, and other customer operations/program leadership positions.
  • Set clear performance expectations, priorities, operating rhythms, and accountability standards for direct reports.
  • Coach team members on customer engagement, communication, escalation management, project execution, executive readiness, and operational ownership.
  • Build leadership capability across the team by developing talent, identifying skill gaps, supporting career growth, and creating development plans.
  • Establish consistent team standards for customer communication, business reviews, contract governance, escalation management, reporting, and follow-through.
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, team operating reviews, performance check-ins, and development conversations.
  • Create a high-accountability, customer-centric culture focused on ownership, proactive communication, operational excellence, and measurable outcomes.
  • Ensure team members are aligned to customer priorities, GE HealthCare strategy, regional objectives, and service delivery commitments.

4. Customer Satisfaction, Retention & Growth

  • Own strategic programs that improve customer satisfaction, customer experience, and long-term retention.
  • Develop and execute customer success strategies that support service partnership health, contract renewal, expansion opportunities, and customer loyalty.
  • Partner with commercial and account teams to identify growth opportunities, renewal risks, service expansion needs, and broader GE HealthCare portfolio solutions.
  • Use customer feedback, performance data, and Voice of Customer insights to drive continuous improvement and strengthen partnership value.
  • Proactively identify risks to customer satisfaction and lead mitigation plans across internal teams.
  • Ensure customer priorities are translated into measurable actions, owners, timelines, and outcomes.

5. Contract, Financial & Business Performance Leadership

  • Provide leadership oversight for service partnership performance against contractual, operational, financial, and customer commitments.
  • Ensure appropriate contract documents, acceptance certificates, variation agreements, governance documentation, and customer-facing commitments are completed accurately and on time.
  • Partner with finance, commercial, service, and operations teams to monitor profitability, cost performance, operational risk, billing issues, and contract health.
  • Establish operational mechanisms to manage long-term program liabilities, customer obligations, quality expectations, safety requirements, and profitability objectives.
  • Support contract renewal strategies, expansion discussions, financial reviews, and customer business planning.
  • Drive accountability for accurate reporting, issue resolution, milestone tracking, and financial performance visibility.

6. Escalation Leadership & Enterprise Problem Resolution

  • Lead senior-level customer escalations and high-visibility service events requiring cross-functional alignment and executive awareness.
  • Act as the customer advocate within GE HealthCare while balancing customer needs, contractual obligations, operational realities, and business objectives.
  • Ensure escalations have clear ownership, timeline, communication plan, root-cause review, and corrective action path.
  • Coordinate across field service, supply chain, engineering, technical support, commercial, finance, and leadership teams to resolve complex issues.
  • Communicate transparently with customer and internal stakeholders during critical events.
  • Drive sustainable corrective actions to prevent repeat issues and improve service delivery.

7. Program Management, Project Execution & Operational Excellence

  • Lead enterprise-level programs, initiatives, and workstreams that support service partnership success.
  • Track programmatic and project progress against agreed plans, customer commitments, KPI targets, operational risks, cost expectations, and performance objectives.
  • Drive operational excellence initiatives that improve efficiency, customer experience, profitability, service delivery, and internal accountability.
  • Collaborate with customers and internal teams to develop and communicate best practices across the enterprise.
  • Ensure program updates, dashboards, action logs, and leadership reports are accurate, timely, and outcome-focused.
  • Hold internal stakeholders accountable for execution of customer commitments and continuous improvement actions.

8. Cross-Functional Leadership & Enterprise Alignment

jobs.description:
About Us

Tameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online. We are looking for a Head of Technical Content to take end-to-end ownership of our technical presence.

About the Role

This is not a standard copywriting role or strategist role. We want someone with an engineering mind and a marketing insight, someone who figures things out, builds things, and ships them without waiting to be told. Someone who understands who our customers are: engineers and procurement teams at small and medium businesses sourcing industrial components, and what they need to make a confident purchase decision. If you are excited about building AI-driven content pipelines, that matters more than a long track record.

You will own technical content from strategy to publication, including its technical accuracy. Your output shapes how engineers find Tameson, how the site ranks, and whether visitors convert into buyers. You work closely with our Product and Operations teams to extract technical knowledge and turn it into content competitors cannot replicate.

A Flavor of What You’d Work On

  • Audit our solenoid valve categories, identify what is missing or underperforming, and decide whether the fix is a selection guide, a page restructure, JSON-LD, or additional supporting content. Build it and analyze performance.

  • Take our internal valve performance test data and turn it into a content series: articles, comparison tables, video scripts, email campaigns, social posts. Build assets from proprietary data that competitors cannot replicate.

  • Work with industry partners to reach their communities through forums, sponsored placements, or native articles on their platforms.

  • Analyze pages that get traffic but do not convert. Investigate whether it is a traffic quality, content quality, or conversion issue, implement a fix, and track the result against sales.

  • Get up to speed on a product you know little about, write a buyer guide, fact-check it against manufacturer datasheets, and publish it without a technical reviewer.

Key Outcomes & Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Ownership: You will identify gaps in our content, style, and approach. You own the solution from idea to publication. You do not wait for a task list. You analyze the site, find the opportunities, and execute the improvements that drive the biggest impact.

  • Strategic Content Architecture: You decide the format that converts. Sometimes an article is best, but often the customer needs a flow calculator, a comparison table, an upgraded category page, a tooltip, diagram, video, or a selection wizard. You will build the right content for the job to build our brand and convert users.

  • Technical Authority & Accuracy: You are responsible for the technical accuracy of all public-facing content. You must have high engineering knowledge to validate data, correct errors, and ensure our advice is sound. You are the filter that prevents AI hallucinations or inaccuracies from reaching the customer.

  • Build the Content Moat: You will create unique value that competitors and AI models cannot replicate. Go beyond text to produce proprietary assets like physical product benchmarks, expert interviews, and deep-dive technical diagrams or videos.

  • Optimize for the Audience: You will structure information to ensure our content ranks high for search engines, serves as a primary citation source for AI models, and provides clear, helpful guidance for humans (engineers, non-engineers, buyers, etc.).

  • Agile Adaptation: You will stay ahead of marketing trends and follow the data. If a content format stops working, you pivot. You track traffic and conversion metrics to continuously refine your strategy.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • High Engineering Knowledge: You have a background in engineering, deep experience in technical industries, and can explain the physics of our products easily.

  • Builds With AI: You have designed and built content workflows using AI: research pipelines, structured drafting processes, automated publishing steps. You chose the tools, connected them, and own the quality of what comes out.

  • Outcome Owner: You are driven by results (traffic, conversion, revenue) rather than output (article or word count). You manage the roadmap and deliver end-to-end results.

  • Collaborative Investigator: You do not work in a silo. You actively partner with our Product and Operations teams to extract their internal expertise. You work with them and translate their knowledge into public-facing content that sets us apart from competitors.

  • Versatile Creator: You are comfortable switching formats and could work on writing a white paper, designing calculator logic, auditing category pages, and building dashboards to analyze results all in 1 week.

Why Choose Tameson?

  • Direct Business Impact: Your work directly correlates to sales. Publish the right guide and you can watch organic traffic and conversions move. There is a direct line between what you produce and company revenue.

  • Innovation: We are an aggressive, modern company. We want you to experiment with new formats, tools, and strategies.

  • Company culture: We value collaboration, professional growth, and fun. We regularly have company activities (online and offline) to stay connected and inspired.

  • Growth: We are scaling rapidly. As we expand, your professional opportunities grow.

Role Work Conditions

  • Employment type: Full time position (remote).

  • Working hours: Flexible work hours, with availability required Monday through Friday and a minimum overlap of 12:00–17:00 GMT+1.

  • Contract type: You will join as an independent contractor. To simplify hiring outside our registered countries, we engage global talent through freelance contracts.

Ready to define the future of industrial e-commerce?

If you have the technical mind to understand our products and the strategic mind to market them, apply today.

Highlights

Tameson seeks a remote Head of Technical Content to build authority, create expert content, and optimize for AI. Independent contractor role.

This role will work closely with the Head of People & Culture to manage and improve key HR processes, including employee documentation, HR systems, payroll coordination, recruitment support, training, and employee-related operations.

We’re looking for someone with hands-on HR or People Operations experience who can take ownership of recurring processes, stay on top of deadlines and follow-ups, identify process gaps, and independently drive tasks to completion.

HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle

  • Prepare and administer offer letters, employment documentation, promotion letters, salary change letters, employment change documentation, probation-related documentation, and other routine employee correspondence.
  • Coordinate onboarding and offboarding activities and ensure required actions are completed by the appropriate internal stakeholders.

  • Support annual and recurring People & Culture processes as required.
  • Maintain confidentiality and exercise appropriate judgment when handling sensitive employee information.

HRIS & BambooHR Administration

Serve as a primary administrator and operational owner of BambooHR, including:

  • Maintaining accurate employee records and employment information.
  • Processing new hires, employee changes, promotions, compensation changes, departures, and other employee lifecycle transactions.
  • Administering time-off policies and employee leave records.
  • Maintaining organizational and reporting information.
  • Supporting BambooHR workflows, approvals, documentation, and employee records.

  • Running and maintaining HR reports.

  • Troubleshooting routine employee and manager questions regarding BambooHR.
  • Identifying opportunities to better utilize BambooHR functionality and automate manual HR processes.
  • Creating and documenting consistent procedures for HRIS administration.

Prior BambooHR experience is strongly preferred; however, candidates with significant experience administering another HRIS and the ability to learn new systems quickly will also be considered.

Payroll Administration

Support and coordinate payroll administration for employees in the United States and United Kingdom, including:

  • Preparing and reviewing payroll-related employee changes.

Recruitment & Hiring Coordination

Training & Compliance Administration

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager / Business Analyst - Consultant
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are Liberum exists to deliver in the environments where most firms struggle.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Liberum exists to deliver in the environments where most firms struggle. Our clients are public sector agencies navigating enterprise-scale transformations in politically complex, high-stakes environments where the margin for error is thin, and the consequences of failure are public. We believe clients deserve real ownership, not warm bodies and hope.

We’re a team first. Not a loose collection of consultants sharing a logo, but a genuine team that pushes each other’s thinking, pressure-tests each other’s work, and shows up when engagements get hard. The people we hire make the team better, not just their own deliverables.

We’re also building an AI-forward consulting practice. Our consultants don’t treat AI as a novelty or a side experiment. They integrate it into how they plan, analyze, build, and deliver. AI is a force multiplier at Liberum, and every practitioner is expected to wield it with the same rigor they bring to their core discipline.

If you’re looking for a comfortable seat and a steady paycheck, this isn’t the role. If you want to be part of a team that does hard things extraordinarily well, with every available advantage. Keep reading.

The Role

This is a dual-capacity position: you will provide both project management leadership and business analysis expertise to support large-scale Washington State ERP initiatives. This is not two half-roles stitched together. It’s a senior-level position for a seasoned professional who can seamlessly shift between driving project delivery and performing rigorous business analysis within the same engagement, often in the same week.

The right candidate brings deep public sector experience, hands-on ERP implementation knowledge, and direct Workday expertise. On the PM side, you bring genuine planning rigor: resource-loaded schedules, dependency mapping, and the discipline to keep plans current and actionable, not decorative artifacts that gather dust. On the BA side, you go beyond documenting requirements to identify gaps and risks the client hasn’t recognized, and you translate complex operational realities into clear, actionable specifications that technical teams can actually build from.

You are an AI-enabled consultant. You use AI tools daily to work faster and smarter, whether that’s rapidly synthesizing meeting notes and interview data into requirements artifacts, using AI to identify patterns and risks in project data, building executive-ready deliverables in a fraction of the time, or automating the repetitive analytical work that bogs down traditional consultants. You don’t see AI as separate from your PM and BA practice. It’s woven into how you operate, and it’s one of the reasons you deliver at a level your peers can’t match.

You operate with an ownership mentality. You drive work forward, take responsibility for outcomes beyond your immediate scope, and build clarity when things are ambiguous or off-track, without waiting for direction. You’re comfortable delivering hard truths to executive stakeholders with data and a solution already in hand. You understand that making your value visible to the client is as important as delivering it.

As a Liberum team member, you collaborate fully, communicate proactively, and never operate in isolation. You see the big picture while owning your piece of it. You make the people and engagements around you better.

What You’ll Do

Project Management & Delivery Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end project management for complex, multi-workstream engagements including scope, schedule, budget, risk, and issue management
  • Develop, maintain, and execute detailed MS Project plans with dependencies, resource loading, and elaborated tasks; apply hybrid Agile/Waterfall approaches appropriate to the engagement context
  • Drive clarity and alignment when project conditions are ambiguous, off-track, or politically complex, including developing recovery plans and realignment strategies when things go sideways
  • Facilitate project status reporting, executive briefings, and governance checkpoints
  • Deliver status updates and executive reporting in visually compelling formats that tell the right story for the right audience, not just data dumps
  • Identify and proactively manage project risks and dependencies across interconnected workstreams

Business Analysis & Requirements

  • Elicit, document, and validate business and functional requirements through structured interviews, workshops, and process observation
  • Develop and maintain business process flow diagrams, gap analyses, use cases, and other analytical artifacts that drive clarity, not just check boxes
  • Assess current state and future state business processes to identify impacts, risks, and opportunities associated with system and operational changes
  • Translate complex business requirements into clear, actionable specifications for technical teams and system integrators, specifications they can actually build from without three rounds of clarification
  • Support configuration, testing, and validation activities related to ERP/Workday implementation workstreams, including UAT planning and execution

AI-Enabled Delivery

  • Use AI tools to rapidly synthesize meeting notes, interview transcripts, and workshop outputs into structured requirements documents, gap analyses, and decision frameworks, compressing days of manual synthesis into hours
  • Use AI for project data analysis: identifying risk patterns across workstreams, surfacing schedule dependencies, forecasting resource conflicts, and generating early-warning indicators that inform proactive decision-making
  • Use AI to accelerate the creation of executive-ready deliverables: status reports, briefing decks, business cases, and analytical artifacts, at a quality and speed that traditional approaches can’t match
  • Use AI as an analytical partner to pressure-test requirements, validate business process logic, identify specification gaps, and stress-test assumptions before they reach technical teams
  • Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging AI tools and techniques that improve PM and BA delivery, and share innovations with the Liberum team to raise the collective capability

Stakeholder & Relationship Management

  • Manage relationships with executive sponsors, steering committees, and cross-functional stakeholders across state agency environments
  • Engage and build foundational relationships with customers, project sponsors, vendors, and external stakeholders
  • Coordinate across vendor, state agency, and internal Liberum team members to ensure integrated delivery
  • Proactively communicate project progress, risks, and value delivered to client stakeholders, ensuring visibility into team contributions throughout the engagement

Team & Client Development

  • Coach and mentor client-side staff to build internal PM and BA capability where applicable
  • Collaborate with OCM, training, and communications teams to ensure PM and BA outputs support adoption and readiness activities
  • Identify opportunities to create additional client value throughout the engagement lifecycle, not just fulfill the SOW, but actively look for ways to make the client better

Requirements

What We Require

These aren’t suggestions. If you can’t back each of these up with specific examples, this isn’t the right fit yet.

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent professional experience
  • 5+ years of combined experience in project management and business analysis roles, with demonstrated senior-level performance in both functions, not just titles but outcomes you can walk us through
  • Direct experience supporting or delivering at least one major ERP implementation (Workday, SAP, Oracle, PeopleSoft, or equivalent)
  • Workday experience: functional knowledge of one or more Workday modules (HCM, Finance, Payroll, etc.) preferred, with hands-on configuration or testing experience ideal
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder projects in highly regulated or politically sensitive environments, where the org chart doesn’t tell you who actually makes decisions
  • Experience facilitating executive-level stakeholder engagement, including steering committees and sponsor briefings
  • Proficiency in developing business process documentation, requirements artifacts, and gap analysis deliverables that drive action, not shelf-ware
  • Experience conducting business interviews and leading client workshops at both operational and leadership levels
  • Active, daily use of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or equivalent) integrated into your PM and BA workflow, not occasional experimentation, but a fundamental part of how you work. You should be able to demonstrate specific examples of how AI has changed your delivery speed, quality, or analytical depth.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI for document synthesis, requirements analysis, data pattern recognition, risk identification, and deliverable creation in a professional consulting context
  • Comfort prompting and directing AI tools effectively. You understand how to get high-quality, contextually appropriate outputs and know the limitations of AI-generated content
  • Intellectual curiosity and initiative around emerging AI capabilities. Proactively experiment with new tools and bring innovations to your team, not wait for someone to assign them
  • Strong writing skills: the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, concise deliverables for both technical audiences and executive stakeholders
  • Hybrid methodology fluency: ability to blend Agile and Waterfall approaches pragmatically based on what the project and client actually need
  • Proficiency in MS Project or equivalent scheduling tools, including dependency mapping and resource-loaded plans
  • Professional courage to deliver difficult findings and recommendations with data, grace, and actionable solutions, not just flag problems, but bring answers
  • Proven ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively within a remote or hybrid team environment
  • Exceptional client relationship management skills
  • PMP certification or equivalent project management credential preferred
  • PMI-PBA or CBAP certification a plus

What Sets You Apart

Not required, but these will move you to the front of the line.

  • Master’s Degree in Business, Public Administration, Information Systems, or related field
  • Consulting experience with public sector clients
  • Experience with COTS implementation in public sector environments
  • Familiarity with Washington State procurement and contracting processes
  • Experience working alongside or managing SI (System Integrator) teams on large-scale ERP programs
  • Prosci or equivalent OCM certification
  • Experience building custom AI workflows, prompt libraries, or automated analytical pipelines that measurably improved consulting delivery
  • Familiarity with AI-powered project analytics, predictive scheduling tools, or automated reporting solutions
  • Track record of introducing AI tools or practices to a team or client organization and driving adoption

Benefits

Why Liberum

  • You’ll work alongside people who are as good at this as you are, a team where excellence is the baseline, not the exception
  • The work is real: complex, politically nuanced, enterprise-scale ERP transformations that actually matter to the State of Washington
  • We’re building an AI-forward practice. You’ll be part of a team that’s redefining how consulting is done, not just doing it the same way with better tools
  • Comprehensive benefits: full medical, dental, life, and short-term disability coverage, plus 401k with 4% match (no vesting period)
  • Competitive compensation: $140,000–$160,000 annually based on experience
  • Generous PTO: 15 days (0–5 years) or 20 days (5+ years), plus 9 paid holidays and WA state sick leave accrual
  • Bonus Leave program for employees who go above and beyond.

Liberum is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate candidates on their ability to do extraordinary work.

jobs.description:
Senior AI Data Engineer

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior AI Data Engineer to design and operate the data foundation that our AI systems depend on. This role owns the movement, modeling, and quality of data from source systems through the warehouse and into the retrieval and feature layers that power LLM pipelines, agentic workflows, and analytical products.

The ideal candidate is a rigorous software engineer first and a data specialist second: someone who models a warehouse deliberately, writes production Python that other engineers can extend, and treats pipelines as versioned, tested, observable software rather than scripts.

This role partners closely with the AI/ML Data Scientist, who owns model behavior and retrieval strategy.

The boundary: you own the pipeline, the schema, and the guarantees; they own the algorithm, the prompt, and the evaluation.

Required Qualifications

5-10+ years in software engineering or data engineering, with substantial time in production data platform work.

Data warehousing: demonstrable command of Kimball dimensional modeling - not just familiarity with the vocabulary, but the judgment to choose a grain, resolve a many-to-many relationship, and know when to denormalize. Working knowledge of alternative approaches (Data Vault, One Big Table, Inman) and the tradeoffs against Kimball.

SQL: expert-level - window functions, CTEs, query plan reading, and performance tuning on a columnar warehouse.

Python: expert-level, production-grade - typing, packaging, dependency management, testing.

Design: SOLID and domain-driven design applied in real systems, with examples you can walk through.

Orchestration: Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or equivalent, in production.

Cloud: expert-level on AWS, Azure, or GCP - storage, compute, IAM, networking, and cost management.

Platform: containerization, Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE), and CI/CD.

Experience with lakehouse table formats (Iceberg, Delta Lake, Hudi) and their maintenance characteristics: compaction, snapshot expiry, schema and partition evolution.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building the data layer beneath production RAG systems, including hybrid search infrastructure and index freshness guarantees.

Streaming systems: Kafka, Kinesis, Flink, or Spark Structured Streaming.

dbt or an equivalent transformation and testing framework.

Data quality tooling (Great Expectations, Soda, or similar) and catalog/lineage platforms.

Familiarity with the model-facing side of the stack - MLflow, Weights & Biases, feature stores - sufficient to collaborate credibly with data scientists.

Working knowledge of a second language: TypeScript, Java, Go, Scala, or Rust.

Experience with AI security, governance, and compliance frameworks.

Open-source contributions to data or AI infrastructure projects.

Because the account stays yours, so does the commission. You earn on the close, and you keep earning every year the account renews. Build a book of eight to ten accounts and you've built a durable, compounding income stream that pays you long after the initial signature.

  • Can carry a conversation from first coffee to signed contract without needing a manager in the room
  • Want to own accounts long-term rather than hand them off

  • Are genuinely self-directed—no hand-holding, no pipeline babysitting

Required Qualifications

  • Commission on close — a competitive percentage of first-year contract value, with a higher rate on the deal sizes most common in this market

Final Note

We view this as a genuine two-way commitment. When there's strong fit and sustained results, we prefer to grow together—expanded scope, strategic partnership, or an equity conversation as the relationship deepens.

This is a chance to build something real: a compounding income stream on your own terms, deeper relationships with operators you already care about, and genuine impact in a market you know better than we do.

Before You Apply

This full-time remote role combines freight management, Amazon FBA coordination, inventory forecasting, and reverse logistics to ensure smooth operations across all sales channels. If you are experienced in e-commerce logistics, Amazon fulfillment, and supply chain optimization, and enjoy working in a fast-paced, high-impact environment, wed love to hear from you.

About the company:

The company is a premium pet brand known for its high-quality, durable bulky pet products and accessories. Built for both professionals and devoted pet owners, the brands products are designed with attention to detail, functionality, and longevity. The brand is committed to creating elevated, practical experiences for pets and their people—and is looking for an Inventory & Logistics Specialist to help scale that mission by ensuring seamless product flow from factory to customer.

Key Responsibilities:

Freight & Supply Chain Management

  • Manage end-to-end order placement with factories and track order progress through to completion.
  • Request, negotiate, and select the best quotes from freight forwarders, determining the optimal type of sea freight for each specific situation.
  • Design ideal loading configurations for shipping containers based on product dimensions to maximize space and reduce shipping costs.
  • Oversee the loading process through active communication with factories and freight partners.
  • Track all global shipments, proactively flagging and mitigating any potential delays.

Amazon FBA & E-commerce Operations

  • Create and manage Amazon Shipments, utilizing software solutions (e.g., 9Yards and similar simulation tools) to run multiple simulations and target the most cost-effective Amazon warehouses.
  • Oversee the receiving of units at both Amazon fulfillment centers and partner 3PL warehouses.
  • Perform thorough reconciliation for all inbound shipments to ensure accurate stock levels and file claims for missing units when necessary.
  • Coordinate Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) orders for Last Mile transport from our 3PL to customers for non-Amazon (DTC/B2B) orders.

Inventory Forecasting & Management

  • Continuously monitor inventory levels across all sales channels to prevent overstocking or Out-of-Stock (OOS) situations.
  • Forecast inventory movements and project OOS dates at the SKU level to accurately plan factory order quantities.

Reverse Logistics & Returns Management

  • Create and manage Amazon removal orders for customer returns.
  • Arrange transport from Amazon to 3PL/processing facilities.
  • Oversee the de-kitting, inspection, and sorting of damaged units into tiers for parts harvesting or resale.

Scale of Operations:

  • Container Shipments: ~8 per month.
  • LTL Orders (Last Mile): ~10 per week.
  • Factory Orders: ~6 per year.

Software & Workflow Proficiency:

  • Amazon FBA & E-commerce Systems: Deep expertise with Amazon Seller Central, FBA placement optimization, inbound reconciliation, and removal/disposal orders.
  • Forecasting & Inventory Management: Hands-on experience with IMS tools (SoStocked, RestockPro, Cin7, Skubana), advanced Excel or Google Sheets for SKU-level forecasting and run-rate models.
  • Logistics, Freight & 3PL Integration: Familiarity with container load planning software (EasyCargo, CubeMaster), freight platforms (Flexport, Freightos), warehouse management systems (ShipStation, ShipHero), and reverse logistics workflows.

Core Competencies

  • 3+ years of experience in supply chain, logistics, or Amazon inventory management.
  • Proven ability to manage complex shipments and multi-stage fulfillment workflows across international markets.
  • Strong understanding of Amazon FBA processes and multi-channel e-commerce operations.
  • Advanced analytical mindset with the ability to build and interpret detailed SKU-level forecasting and inventory models.
  • Practical experience coordinating international freight, container shipments, and 3PL operations in a multi-channel environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and high attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently while coordinating with multiple stakeholders.
  • Alignment with the companys premium brand standards and operational excellence mindset.

Why Join Us:

  • Play a critical role in ensuring smooth operations for a high-ticket pet brand on Amazon.
  • Own inventory planning, logistics, and fulfillment workflows.
  • Work remotely from anywhere.
  • Competitive salary and flexible working hours.
  • Collaborate with a creative, forward-thinking team dedicated to innovation in the pet space.
  • Make a tangible impact on a brand that values quality, customer experience, and operational excellence.

Job Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Linux Infrastructure Engineer with deep expertise in Linux administration, bare metal infrastructure, enterprise storage, and next-generation AI Factory / GPU infrastructure platforms. This role is focused on designing, deploying, operating, and troubleshooting large-scale Linux-based infrastructure that powers both traditional enterprise workloads and modern AI/ML environments.

This is not a DevOps-focused role. We already have a dedicated DevOps team and are looking for an engineer with extensive hands-on experience in Bare Metal as a Service (BMaaS), GPU infrastructure, high-performance storage, data center operations, and enterprise Linux platforms.

The ideal candidate will have experience building and managing infrastructure from the hardware layer up, including servers, networking, storage, GPU clusters, and AI-ready platforms. They should be comfortable working with high-performance computing (HPC), AI Factory environments, and large-scale Linux deployments where performance, reliability, and operational excellence are critical.

Key Responsibilities & Required Skills

Linux & Bare Metal Infrastructure

  • Expert-level Linux administration (Ubuntu required; Red Hat and SUSE preferred)
  • Deep expertise in bare metal server deployment, architecture, provisioning, and lifecycle management
  • Experience operating Bare Metal as a Service (BMaaS) platforms and large-scale infrastructure environments
  • Strong understanding of server hardware, including:
    • BIOS/UEFI
    • RAID controllers
    • Firmware management
    • iLO/iDRAC/IPMI
    • NICs and SmartNICs
    • HBA cards

AI Factory & GPU Infrastructure

    • A100, H100, H200, B200, or equivalent GPU platforms

    • GPU provisioning and lifecycle management
    • GPU monitoring and performance optimization
  • Knowledge of AI Factory architecture and infrastructure requirements
  • Experience supporting GPU clusters, AI training environments, and high-performance computing (HPC) workloads
  • Understanding of:
    • GPU resource allocation and scheduling
    • Multi-GPU systems
    • GPU networking requirements
    • High-bandwidth, low-latency infrastructure design
  • Familiarity with NVIDIA ecosystem technologies such as:
    • CUDA
    • NCCL
    • GPUDirect Storage
    • NVIDIA Fabric Manager
    • NVIDIA Base Command (preferred)

Enterprise Storage & Data Platforms

  • Advanced Linux storage administration:
    • LVM
    • XFS, EXT4
    • NFS
    • iSCSI
    • Fibre Channel SAN
    • Multipath I/O
  • Strong hands-on experience with Ceph, including:
    • Cluster architecture
    • MON, OSD, MDS
    • RBD, CephFS, RGW
    • Capacity planning
    • Performance tuning
    • Failure recovery
  • Experience with high-performance AI storage platforms such as:
    • WEKA
    • VAST Data
    • Dell PowerScale
    • Pure Storage FlashBlade
    • NetApp
  • Understanding of:
    • NVMe-over-Fabrics (NVMe-oF)
    • RDMA
    • GPUDirect Storage
    • Parallel file systems
    • AI data pipelines

Networking & Infrastructure

  • Strong networking knowledge:
    • Bonding
    • VLANs
    • Routing
    • MTU optimization
    • DNS
    • DHCP
  • Experience with high-performance data center networking:
    • 100G/200G/400G Ethernet
    • RoCE
    • RDMA
    • Spine-Leaf architectures
  • Familiarity with NVIDIA Spectrum-X, Mellanox/NVIDIA ConnectX adapters, or equivalent technologies
  • Strong understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 infrastructure design and troubleshooting

Operations & Reliability

  • Experience with high availability, clustering, and disaster recovery
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across:
    • Linux operating systems
    • Hardware platforms
    • GPU infrastructure
    • Networking
    • Enterprise storage
  • Experience supporting mission-critical production environments
  • Bash and Python scripting for automation and operational efficiency
  • Experience creating operational documentation, runbooks, and infrastructure standards

Nice to Have

  • Kubernetes infrastructure (especially AI/ML and GPU integration)
  • KVM, VMware, OpenShift Virtualization, or similar virtualization platforms
  • Ansible automation
  • NVIDIA Base Command Manager

  • Observability and monitoring platforms (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry)
  • Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) tools
  • IPAM solutions
  • AWS, Azure, or hybrid cloud exposure

We Are Not Looking For

  • Candidates whose experience is primarily CI/CD pipeline engineering

Ideal Candidate

Someone who has spent years designing, building, and operating enterprise Linux environments, large-scale bare metal infrastructure, storage platforms, and modern AI Factory environments. The ideal candidate understands how to deploy and manage GPU-enabled infrastructure, BMaaS platforms, enterprise storage, and high-performance networking while solving complex operating system, hardware, storage, and AI infrastructure challenges. You will work closely with the Senior Growth Marketing Lead, Channel Directors, and VP of Marketing to execute marketing initiatives across a growing portfolio. This is an execution-focused role where you will help refine and improve existing strategies rather than create them from scratch.

  2. Partner Enablement

Product Marketing

Content & Portfolio Support

  • Support development of datasheets, solution briefs, competitive positioning documents, FAQs, and other product marketing assets.

  • Maintain and refresh product and security content as services and integrations evolve.

Your First 90 Days

  • Learn the Environment
  • Audit existing partner-facing and product marketing assets.
  • Meet with Channel Directors to understand partner sales motions and content gaps.
  • Start Delivering
  • Produce priority channel enablement assets.
  • Take ownership of the channel newsletter.
  • Execute Campaigns
  • Run at least one partner-led campaign from launch through reporting.

What We Need

We are a small senior marketing team working in a fast-paced environment with high visibility and high expectations. You will work closely with Channel Directors, sales leadership, and technology partners, and your work will have direct impact across the business.

This role suits someone who:

  • takes ownership and executes well within an existing strategy,
  • stays calm and organised under pressure,
  • is proactive and self-directed,
  • communicates confidently and works well with strong personalities,
  • is resilient and adaptable in a fast-moving environment.

This role sits at the intersection of field, channel, and content. You’ll work closely with the Senior Growth Marketing Lead to take our overarching strategy, positioning, and content and turn it into partner-ready programs and assets that are clear, practical, and easy to apply.

You’ll help partners recognize opportunities, position us confidently, and know when to bring us into a deal.

Working closely with the channel team, you’ll support marketing activity across initiatives — from partner campaigns to events, ensuring what we produce is aligned, well executed, and useful in the field.

  3. Develop partner-ready win stories that clearly show how and where we create value, giving partners practical examples they can use in conversations

Campaign Execution & Co-Marketing

  3. Work closely with sales and channel teams to ensure campaigns are aligned to real opportunities and priorities

  3. Manage the operational side of campaigns and events, including coordination, logistics, audience lists, and internal alignment

jobs.excerpt: Build the products.  Tell the story. 4AM Media owns and operates 3 DTC brands across health, cleaning, and pets.
jobs.description:
Build the products. Tell the story.

4AM Media owns and operates 3 DTC brands across health, cleaning, and pets. Last year we spent over $40M across paid media scaling our own products. We're not an agency. We're operators with supply chain, creative, custom funnels, media buying, analytics, and customer service all under one roof.

We're hiring a Product Manager dedicated to our cleaning brand. This is a hybrid PM + PMM role. You'll own everything from customer research and product roadmap through go-to-market strategy, content, and community. You'll report directly to the CEO and work alongside the creative manager, supply chain director, media buyers, marketplace lead, and ops manager as your peer group.

This role is built for someone with agency. We have the infrastructure including a sourcing team in China, in-house creative, media buyers, supply chain, finance. What we need is the operator who pulls all of it together to ship better products faster, position them right, and make sure customers actually find and love them.

What you'll own

Customer research and product intelligence

You're the person who knows our customer better than anyone in the building.

  • You read every NPS response, every customer service ticket, every product review, every survey
  • You run regular customer surveys and 1-on-1 calls because you can't make good product decisions without them
  • You know what customers love, what they hate, what they keep asking for, and what they don't even know they need yet
  • You synthesize all of this into clear product insights the rest of the company can act on

Product strategy and roadmap

Our cleaning brand's product line spans tablet formulas, powder formulations, and electronic devices (power scrubber, air purifier), with additional formats and form factors on the roadmap. You own what comes next.

  • You build a consistent product pipeline that compounds
  • You know which products are hero SKUs for new customer acquisition, which are upsells that drive AOV, and which are retention plays that build LTV
  • Every product has a subscription path. You design the products and offers with that in mind from day one
  • You build (and constantly refine) our new product criteria framework and you use it to make hard go/no-go calls
  • You understand COGS, margin structure, and shipping requirements well enough to kill a product before it eats six months of the team's time
  • You study our existing funnels and paid media performance to understand which product types customers respond to — and you let that data shape what you build

Existing product improvements

  • Some of our current products need work. You'll identify which ones, why, and what to do about it including improved formulas, better form factors, or full replacements

Product development execution

  • You write the PRDs the supply chain director needs to brief our China team
  • You work directly with our team in China during R&D and sample rounds supplying mockups, 3D renderings, written specs, and clear feedback on each round
  • You're the tastemaker and the economist. You own the final call on what we launch and what we don't, balancing customer fit, margin, and operational reality
  • Travel to China roughly once a year for factory visits, sample reviews, and relationship building

Compliance and operational fit

  • You think about compliance and shipping reality before we commit to a product, not after we've already designed it
  • You're comfortable using AI and modern research tools to come up to speed on regulatory questions you haven't encountered before
  • You know the channel realities: marketplace listing requirements, shipping classifications, ad platform policy restrictions for cleaning products. No surprises after the box is printed.

Go-to-market strategy

Before a product launches, you already know how it'll be sold.

  • Is this a top-of-funnel hero across multiple paid channels? A search-only play? A creator seeding push on social? A marketplace-first launch? You decide based on the product, the customer, and what we know works
  • You build the GTM plan with the media buyers and the creative strategist. You bring the product POV, they bring channel and creative expertise, and together you ship the right launch

Positioning and offer strategy

You make sure every product launches with a clear point of view.

  • You own the product brief: customer personas, purchase drivers, key selling points, recommended angles, FAQ, objection handling
  • You recommend the pricing and offer structure: bundles, subscribe-and-save mechanics, BOGO, intro offers, AOV-builder upsells. You bring the recommendations. The team aligns and tests.
  • You write edit the customer service product training so the CS team answers questions accurately and on-brand
  • You're the source of truth on every product. When the buyer team needs to know "what's the unique mechanism?" or "how long is the battery life" they will come to you.

Content, community, and partnerships

You're the customer voice inside the building, so you also become the customer voice on our channels.

  • You'll engage and energize our creator community to help them spread the word and create high converting content for our paid media channels.
  • You'll collect feedback from our creator community to help inform the product pipeline.

What we need you to bring

  • 5+ years in product management, brand management, or product marketing for a DTC ecommerce brand. Ideally in a physical product category (CPG, beauty, home goods, pet, health). Pure software PM experience won't translate
  • You've shipped real physical products from concept to market. You've written PRDs, worked with overseas factories, navigated samples and revisions, managed launch timelines.
  • DTC ecommerce native. You understand AOV, LTV, CAC, subscription mechanics, and the unit economics that make or break a product launch
  • Customer-obsessed in practice, not just in slogan. You've actually run surveys, read tickets, called customers, sat in CS queues. You can point to product decisions you made because of what you heard
  • GTM fluency. You've planned product launches across paid media, marketplace, and content channels. You know what works for what kind of product
  • Strong written communication. PRDs, briefs, FAQs, social copy, partnership outreach. You write clearly and you write a lot
  • Content and creator instincts. You know what makes content work on TikTok and Instagram. You've worked with creators and partners and have opinions on what good looks like
  • Strong operator energy and agency. You don't wait for someone to tell you what's broken. You find it, you scope the fix, you pull in the right peers, and you ship it
  • Willingness to travel to China occasionally for factory visits and sample work
  • Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate research, regulatory work, content drafts, and analysis. We expect leverage, not just hours

Why this role is different

  • You report directly to the CEO. The product strategy for the brand is yours.
  • You're the central node. Creative, supply chain, media buying, marketplace, ops — they're all your peers, and your job is to pull them together around the product. The role is built for someone who likes that kind of leverage
  • You stay in the work. This isn't a role where you write Asana tickets and manage handoffs. You're talking to customers, writing PRDs, briefing creators, posting content, reviewing samples, and shipping launches. Hands-on across the full lifecycle
  • Real growth path. Crush this role and the path expands — more brands under your product leadership, growing the product function, or expanded scope across the company

What success looks like in 12 months

  • You've built and shipped the new product criteria framework, and the company uses it to make go/no-go calls
  • You've launched at least 2-3 new SKUs that hit their commercial targets, plus meaningfully improved at least one existing product
  • The media buyers can launch your products faster and better because the product brief, angles, and offer structure are clear before they get the file
  • The CEO trusts your product judgment — you've earned it through clear thinking, fast execution, and results
  • The brand has a 6-12 month product roadmap that's exciting, defensible, and tied to real customer insight

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

The Senior Accountant – Accounts Receivable is responsible for the Accounts Receivable and Order-to-Cash activities of DA-Desk and Marcura Platform Solutions, covering billing, collections, cash application, and revenue recognition and reporting — ensuring accuracy, timely recovery of receivables, and clear visibility of customer outstanding balances for the business.

The role brings standardisation to customer-level visibility of revenue, invoicing and outstanding balances, and holds ownership of collections performance for an assigned customer portfolio, including ageing, DSO and overdue exposure. It requires a sound understanding of the business and its revenue drivers, the ability to manage large data sets and present up-to-date insights, control over pricing in the revenue systems, and effective partnering with Sales and Account Management on outstanding invoices, billing queries and customer escalations.

Requirements

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Maintain up-to-date, detailed pricing data to support invoicing and revenue management.
  • Apply control checks on invoicing data across all revenue streams.
  • Participate in the end-to-end Accounts Receivable process, from invoice generation through to collection and cash application.
  • Prepare, review and issue customer invoices accurately and on schedule, ensuring supporting data, tariffs and contractual terms are correctly applied before dispatch, and resolving discrepancies prior to release.
  • Manage collections for an assigned customer portfolio: monitor ageing reports, follow up on overdue invoices through structured dunning, and escalate long-outstanding or high-risk accounts in line with the agreed escalation matrix.
  • Issue statements of account and payment reminders, and record committed payment dates and collection notes to maintain a reliable receivables and cash-inflow forecast.
  • Perform cash application on a daily basis, allocating incoming receipts to the correct customer invoices and matching remittance advices accurately.
  • Interact with Sales and Account Management on outstanding invoices — sharing overdue positions, obtaining customer feedback, resolving billing queries and disputes, and jointly agreeing recovery actions on ageing accounts.
  • Coordinate and assist in year-end finalisation and audits, providing AR schedules and supporting documentation.

REQUIREMENTS

Minimum Education/Qualification

Bachelor of Commerce (CMA, CA, B. Com or BBA); accounting certifications an advantage.

Min. Experience

  • 4+ years’ experience in accounts receivable, billing or order-to-cash
  • Direct communication with customers on billing and collections matters

Industry

  • Order-to-cash, billing, collections or revenue accounting environment
  • Maritime technology, shipping services or a transaction-based business preferred

Technical Skills

  • Hands-on experience across the end-to-end order-to-cash cycle: billing, collections and cash application
  • ERP experience (NetSuite or equivalent), including the AR and billing modules
  • Maintenance of pricing and tariff data in revenue systems, including approval controls

Senior Accountant – Accounts Receivable

Page 2

  • Control over credit notes and amendments to issued invoices
  • Cash application, remittance matching and clearing of unapplied, unidentified or short-paid receipts
  • Statements of account, structured dunning and escalation processes
  • Revenue reconciliation between invoicing and operational data
  • Monthly revenue reporting, budget deviation analysis and forecasting models
  • Analytics and data visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI) for AR, billing and revenue reporting
  • Advanced Excel, with the ability to manage and interpret large data sets

Languages

• English (fluent)

SUCCESS FACTORS — WHAT THIS LOOKS LIKE IN PRACTICE

Billing & Invoicing Accuracy

Invoices are prepared, checked against tariffs and contractual terms, and issued on schedule, with discrepancies resolved before release.

Collections Performance

Overdue invoices in the assigned portfolio are followed up through structured dunning and escalated as required; receivables KPIs, including DSO and ageing, remain within company benchmarks.

Cash Application

Receipts are allocated to the correct invoices on a daily basis, with unidentified, unapplied and short-paid items investigated and cleared promptly.

Interaction with Sales

Overdue positions are shared with Sales and Account Management, billing queries and disputes are resolved jointly, and accounts requiring credit hold or escalation are flagged for decision.

Pricing & Billing Controls

Pricing data, tariff approvals, credit notes and invoice amendments are controlled and correctly applied, with a clear audit trail maintained.

Customer Service & Audit Support

External customers receive prompt, high-quality service in all dealings, and year-end finalisation and audit requests are supported with complete AR schedules.

jobs.description:
Location: Canada (Remote)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Industry: Mission-Critical Facilities, Data Centers
Travel: Occasional travel within Canada and the United States, as required by project needs

Role Summary

Ehvert Mission Critical, a business unit within Salas O'Brien, is seeking a highly experienced Power Studies Engineer to join our team and support the analysis and design of complex electrical power systems for hyperscale and AI data centers across Canada and North America. This is a remote role within an innovative, international engineering firm recognized for its cutting-edge work in mission-critical infrastructure.

As a Power Studies Engineer, you will play a key role in evaluating electrical system performance, reliability, and resiliency through advanced power system studies and modeling. You will work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, utility providers, and project stakeholders to develop solutions for high-density AI and mission-critical facilities where system reliability and uptime are paramount.

This role offers the opportunity to work on high-impact projects for global clients in the hyperscale data center market while advancing your career in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

What We Offer

  • Experience in a high-tech industry within an international company
  • Opportunity to work on unique, cutting-edge hyperscale and AI data center projects
  • Comprehensive training and professional development opportunities
  • Supportive leadership and a collaborative team environment
  • Career growth and advancement opportunities
  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including extended health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, paid vacation, retirement savings program (where applicable), and other employee benefits
  • Stock ownership / synthetic equity opportunities
  • Flexible remote work environment

What You Will Do

  • Perform power system studies including load flow, short circuit, protective device coordination, arc flash, grounding, power quality, harmonic analysis, transient analysis, and reliability studies.
  • Develop and maintain electrical system models using PSCAD, ETAP, SKM PowerTools, EasyPower, or similar software platforms.
  • Perform electromagnetic transient (EMT) studies to evaluate system behavior during switching events, faults, utility disturbances, and large load changes.
  • Analyze the impact of high-density AI loads and other mission-critical electrical loads on utility systems, emergency generation, UPS systems, and facility electrical infrastructure.
  • Support utility interconnection studies and coordinate with utility providers regarding service requirements and system performance.
  • Evaluate system reliability, redundancy strategies, contingency scenarios, and overall power system resiliency.
  • Prepare technical reports, engineering calculations, study documentation, and engineering recommendations.
  • Collaborate with electrical design teams on medium-voltage systems, substations, standby generation, UPS systems, mechanical system electrical load characteristics, and utility service infrastructure.
  • Participate in design coordination meetings with clients, consultants, utility providers, and project stakeholders.
  • Support commissioning activities and provide technical expertise during project execution.
  • Review engineering deliverables for technical accuracy, quality, and compliance with applicable industry standards.

What We Expect

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university.
  • 8–15 years of experience in power systems engineering, utility engineering, substations, transmission and distribution, industrial facilities, renewable energy, mining, or mission-critical infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated experience performing power system studies, including transient, harmonic, grounding, load flow, short circuit, protective device coordination, and arc flash analysis.
  • Proficiency with PSCAD is required.
  • Experience with ETAP, SKM PowerTools, EasyPower, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, CYME, or similar power system analysis software.
  • Strong understanding of electrical power systems, utility infrastructure, substations, protective relaying, and system reliability.
  • Experience with utility interconnections and medium-voltage power systems.
  • Experience performing underground duct bank ampacity and heat studies (Neher-McGrath methodology) is considered an asset.
  • Registration as a Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) in Canada, or eligibility to obtain registration, is considered an asset.
  • Strong knowledge of the Canadian Electrical Code (CEC), CSA standards, IEEE standards, utility requirements, and applicable provincial electrical regulations. Familiarity with U.S. codes and standards (NEC, NFPA, IEEE) is considered an asset.
  • Excellent technical writing, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to effectively present technical findings and recommendations to clients.
  • Experience supporting data center, utility, industrial, or other large-scale infrastructure projects is highly desirable.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on cutting-edge hyperscale and AI data center projects in one of the world's fastest-growing industries.
  • Collaborate with industry-leading professionals on complex mission-critical infrastructure projects across North America.
  • Enjoy competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and outstanding career development opportunities.
  • Thrive in a collaborative environment that encourages innovation through exposure to advanced power system analysis, utility coordination, digital twins, BIM technologies, computational fluid dynamics, and custom engineering software solutions.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit their resume outlining their relevant experience and qualifications.

Join Ehvert Mission Critical, a business unit within Salas O'Brien, and help shape the future of mission-critical infrastructure and next-generation AI data centers across North America.

Our Culture

Making our ambitious vision a reality will not be easy. So we don’t hide the truth…it’s not easy to work here. We’re bringing together a special team obsessed with their work and cultivating a culture characterized by many things, including but not limited to:
- Uncommon hard work and commitment;

- Refusal to compromise on standards for quality;

- Radical transparency + direct communication & feedback;

We're early and brand partnerships is the most important focus at the company. jobs.excerpt: Deployment Strategist (DS) & Senior Deployment Strategist (Sr.
jobs.description:
Deployment Strategist (DS) & Senior Deployment Strategist (Sr. DS)

About MelodyArc

MelodyArc is building the orchestration layer for enterprise service work — where rules, people, and AI collaborate to get complex operations done reliably at scale. Our orchestration core (the Point Engine) enables teams to configure agentic AI Operators that execute work end-to-end while leveraging existing business logic and human-in-the-loop workflows. Learn More.

Role Overview

As a Deployment Strategist, you are the owner of the customer's outcome. You take a signed customer from kickoff through a production deployment that is live, adopted, and demonstrably delivering value — and you own everything non-engineering required to get there. You are the "product manager for the field" paired with client single point of contact: you define what gets built and why, you relentlessly manage scope and timeline, and you drive the engagement to a successful landing in production.

This is a delivery-first role. You will spend most of your time defining process and use cases, scoping deployments, authoring the requirements that guide the build, running the engagement as a hands-on project owner, acting as the primary QA tester for the customer's solution, driving adoption after launch, and communicating financial ROI. You partner with our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), who own the how — the deep technical build — while you own the what, the why, and the path to a landed outcome.

Our best Deployment Strategists are unusually resourceful operators who combine strategic business experience in large organizations, product-style thinking, executive communication, and a "whatever it takes to ship" mindset. You are comfortable in a customer's data and workflows, you can read and configure aspects of the Point Engine, but are not expected to build production software. You know exactly when to pull in an FDE.

How This Role Relates to the Forward Deployed Engineering

The Deployment Strategist and the Forward Deployed Engineer are partners on every engagement. The split is deliberate:

  • Deployment Strategist owns the problem--sometimes even supporting the proof of concept build pre-sign--the requirements, scope, timeline, stakeholder management, QA, and adoption. The DS is technical enough to configure the platform, write basic queries, map data, and validate solutions hands-on — but does not own the production codebase.
  • Forward Deployed Engineer owns the technical build: custom integrations, complex configuration, and production-grade engineering.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of customer deployments — from kickoff through a live, adopted, value-proven production solution — as the single accountable owner of the outcome.
  • Scope each deployment: define the minimum viable solution, success criteria, milestones, and timeline, and translate the customer's business problem into a clear requirements document (PRD) that guides the FDE build team.
  • Run the engagement as a hands-on project owner: prioritize the backlog, manage scope relentlessly, sequence milestones, and drive day-to-day execution alongside FDEs.
  • Act as the primary QA tester for the customer's solution — validate that what is built actually solves the problem before it reaches the customer.
  • Configure the MelodyArc platform directly where appropriate (workflow configuration, data mapping, queries, light scripting) and know when to hand deeper technical work to an FDE.
  • Manage all stakeholder communication, from frontline operators to senior sponsors, and act as the escalation owner who unblocks technical, political, and process issues.
  • Own the launch: run the go-live, manage the cutover, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value.
  • Scope the ongoing support and maintenance plan, create customer-facing documentation and enablement, and ensure a clean handoff to steady-state.
  • Partner with Sales and Account teams on discovery and value scoping for new and expansion opportunities, drawing on your trusted-advisor relationship with the customer.

Basic Qualifications

  • 4+ years (DS) or 7+ years (Sr. DS) of client-facing delivery experience in roles such as deployment strategy, technical program/project management, solutions/implementation consulting, or product management at a technology company or top-tier consultancy.
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex projects end-to-end: scoping, sequencing milestones, managing scope, and shipping to production or launch.
  • Strong product and systems thinking: able to translate an ambiguous business problem into clear requirements, success criteria, and a prioritized plan.
  • Technical fluency: comfortable working hands-on in data and workflow tooling — reading and writing SQL, mapping data, configuring software, and validating solutions — without requiring an engineer for routine tasks.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the executive presence to build trust and drive decisions with senior stakeholders.
  • A relentless, hands-on execution mentality — willing to do the unglamorous work required to land a deployment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience deploying enterprise software, data, or AI/ML solutions into production at named accounts.
  • Experience writing PRDs and running an agile delivery process with an engineering team.
  • Experience with value-based scoping (ROI) and quantifying business outcomes for senior stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with customer service operations, contact-center workflows, or business-process operations.
  • Comfort with light scripting, APIs, and integration concepts (enough to scope and validate, not to build production systems).
  • Prior experience in a "founder," "builder," or early-team capacity at a high-growth startup.

Location

Remote (United States). Some travel to customer sites may be required.

Equal Opportunity

MelodyArc is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by law. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, let your recruiter know and we'll work with you.

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $150,000–$185,000. This is a good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay on hire; where an offer lands depends on experience, skills, and work location. As an early-stage company, total compensation also includes equity. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company match, flexible paid time off, and paid parental leave.

Salary: $150,000 – $185,000 / year

About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online.
